Market today: The mood is cautious for tech, driven by Alibaba's earnings hit from heavy AI spending. This suggests other tech names might face similar profit pressures, which could weigh on your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down over 50% and leveraged. SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is also down 40% and needs close watching. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH and QQQI are still in trim status and down.

Watch: Keep an eye on how other major tech players report earnings, especially regarding AI investment costs. Also, monitor overall market volatility given your leveraged positions.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged losers and respecting stops to protect capital.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL further or tightening its stop; a 50%+ loss on a leveraged ETF is dangerous.
SPAL is new and already down 40%; review its stop and position size given its leveraged nature.
ASML shows a scanner BUY setup (entry 1749.98-1748.23, stop 1744.51) in a daily discount, but adding more tech concentration needs careful thought.
